title: Bee Removal in Ardsley, NY
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, and yellow jacket nest removal in Ardsley, Westchester. Carpenter bee and ground bee treatment. Licensed experts. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: Active wasp, hornet, or yellow jacket nest in your Ardsley home? The Best Pest Control NYC provides professional stinging insect removal throughout Westchester County, including all of Ardsley's residential neighborhoods and commercial properties. Our licensed technicians locate and treat nests in wall voids, soffits, attics, and eaves, remove accessible nest material, and seal entry points to prevent recolonization. We also treat carpenter bee galleries and ground-nesting bees.
whyUs: With over a decade serving Westchester communities, Best Pest Control NYC combines local expertise with safe, humane bee removal practices. Our licensed technicians respond quickly to Ardsley properties, offering transparent pricing between $350-$550 and guaranteed results that keep bees from returning.
localContext: Ardsley's tree-lined streets and charming Tudor and Colonial homes provide ideal nesting spots for wasps, hornets, and carpenter bees — especially in attics, eaves, soffits, and the wood trim common to the village's older architecture near Pascone Park. The proximity to the Saw Mill River and abundance of flowering gardens draw foraging activity throughout spring and summer months, increasing the likelihood of nest establishment in wall voids and structural wood.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in Ardsley?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Ardsley?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: How quickly can you respond to a wasp or hornet problem in Ardsley?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and next-day service for most Ardsley wasp and hornet removal requests. Because nests can grow quickly and defensive behavior can escalate during warmer months, we prioritize rapid response to protect your family and property.

faqs.question: Will wasps or hornets come back after nest removal?
faqs.answer: Our service includes nest treatment, removal of accessible nest material, and sealing of every entry point to prevent recolonization by the same species. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
